description: Deterministic e2e scenario proving corrupted citations fail closed (SNIPPET_HASH_MISMATCH, no overlay) and exports are blocked by default (EXPORT_BLOCKED).
overview: Protect the PoC safety posture: corrupted citations must fail closed in the viewer with an explicit reason_code and no overlay, and exports must be blocked by default when deterministic verification fails.
goals: Prove fail-closed viewer behavior for corrupted citations (explicit reason_code; no overlay polygons).
Prove export gating blocks unsafe outputs by default when any row fails deterministic verification.
Provide machine-executable acceptance criteria for automation.
nonGoals: Exercising unsafe override flows requiring admin token (demo-only).
successMetrics: Viewer shows `reason_code: SNIPPET_HASH_MISMATCH` for cit_TB_BAD_1 and renders zero highlight polygons.
Export CSV displays an `EXPORT_BLOCKED` error state in the UI.
openQuestions: Should automation assert the exact reason_code string, or allow an allowlist of fail-closed codes?

stories.title: Fail-Closed Viewer + Export Blocked
stories.description: As a reviewer, if citation integrity breaks, the viewer fails closed with explicit reason_code and no overlay, and exports are blocked by default when deterministic verification fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Seed pack_01_clean via `pnpm fixture:seed pack_01_clean --overwrite` and run dev server with `SPIKES_ENABLED=1 pnpm dev`.
Navigate to `/matters?pack=pack_01_clean` and assert row `TB-BAD-CITATION` exists with status `citation_failed` and citation chip `cit_TB_BAD_1`.
Click `Export CSV` and assert a visible error message starting with `EXPORT_BLOCKED:` and containing `Export blocked`.
Click citation chip `cit_TB_BAD_1` and assert the viewer shows `citation_failed` with `reason_code: SNIPPET_HASH_MISMATCH`.
Assert the viewer highlight overlay renders zero `<polygon>` elements when in citation_failed state (no overlay).
Negative: The fail-closed reason_code panel must be visible without scrolling (not hidden behind loading or collapsed UI).
